data.title: Associate Product Manager
data.description:
About the Role

We're looking for an Associate Product Manager to drive Recruit's product strategy and roadmap. You'll own core ATS features, define how AI enhances recruiter workflows, and work with engineering, design, and applied AI teams to ship capabilities that improve hiring outcomes.

This is a hands-on role where you'll define product priorities, gather recruiter feedback, write clear requirements, and own delivery from discovery through launch. You'll balance foundational ATS improvements with emerging AI capabilities—shipping both with equal rigor.

This role demands strong product instincts, hands-on experience shipping features, and comfort working with AI/LLM capabilities as part of the product toolkit.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Ownership

  • Own the Recruit product roadmap—prioritizing features based on recruiter needs and business impact
  • Write clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria grounded in user research and feedback
  • Partner with engineering and design to translate requirements into shipped features
  • Identify where AI can enhance recruiter workflows; evaluate opportunities based on impact, feasibility, and business value
  • Gather and synthesize customer feedback; measure outcomes post-launch and iterate

AI Strategy & Opportunities

  • Lead discovery of high-impact AI use cases by understanding recruiter pain points and workflow gaps
  • Define the product vision for how AI and automation reshape recruiter workflows over time
  • Establish a prioritization framework for AI opportunities—balancing recruiter impact, technical feasibility, and ROI
  • Partner with applied AI/ML teams on feature design, evaluation, and validation

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to understand recruiter problems and communicate roadmap
  • Collaborate with applied AI/ML teams to scope capabilities, define success metrics, and validate AI features
  • Conduct user research and workflow analysis to identify high-impact opportunities
  • Present roadmap priorities and trade-offs to stakeholders; defend decisions with data

Execution & Accountability

  • Define KPIs and success metrics for every initiative—adoption, feature usage, recruiter satisfaction, business impact
  • Drive sprint planning and backlog grooming with engineering
  • Ensure on-time, quality delivery of roadmap commitments
  • Own end-to-end delivery and learning from launches

Must Have

  • 2–4 years of Product Management experience, with hands-on involvement in shipping features
  • Experience using LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to augment PM workflows—drafting, research, analysis, synthesis
  • Proven ability to ship features through cross-functional collaboration with engineering and design
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills—comfortable gathering customer feedback, writing clear requirements, and presenting to stakeholders
  • Comfortable with product tools—Jira, Confluence, Figma, or similar
  • Solid Agile/Scrum experience working in cross-functional teams
  • Understanding of AI product realities—accuracy concerns, user trust, evaluation, grounding sources
  • Ability to learn quickly and dive deep into new domains

Good to Have

  • Experience in recruiting, HR tech, or similar SaaS domains
  • Familiarity with competitive positioning or emerging tech categories
  • Exposure to responsible AI practices or bias detection
  • Hands-on exposure to AI recruitment tools or competitive AI capabilities

What Success Looks Like (12 Months)

  • Ship 3–4 high-quality features or initiatives with clear business value—mix of core ATS and AI capabilities
  • Develop a prioritized roadmap with stakeholder alignment and leadership buy-in
  • Own end-to-end delivery—from discovery through launch, measurement, and learning
  • Build strong relationships with engineering, design, applied AI teams, sales, and customer-facing teams
  • Establish a repeatable process for product discovery, requirements, and validation
  • Define and track metrics that demonstrate product impact on recruiters and business
  • Demonstrate product judgment—make trade-offs confidently and defend decisions with data

data.title: Program Manager - GTM
data.description:
About greytHR

greytHR is a full-suite HRMS with agentic AI capabilities — payroll, leave & attendance, performance management, recruitment, and employee self-service, used by 33,000+ organisations and 3.3 million+ users across 25+ countries. We're one of the largest HR tech platforms serving India, the Middle East, and Anglophone Africa, and we're scaling further.

About the team

Our GTM function drives new sales and upsell pipeline through digital channels. It's structured as a matrix: four engine teams (Digital, Product Marketing, Brand & Social, Product-Led Growth) build the playbooks, content, and channels; four go-to-market pods (SMB + Mid-Market India, Enterprise/LBU, Middle East & Global, Partners & PSPs) pull from those engine teams to execute against segment-specific pipeline goals. Roughly 30 people run this system today, coordinated through a shared GTM Desk.

About the role

We're hiring a GTM Program Manager to own the operating system that connects the four engine teams and four pods — turning plans into shipped work, on schedule, with clean handoffs and a paper trail leadership can trust. You'll work across every track (not embedded in just one), which means your day spans coordinating a Digital campaign launch for the Enterprise pod, tracking a Product Marketing deliverable for the ME pod, and running the weekly cadence that keeps all four pods and four engines in sync.

This is a hands-on execution role for someone who has done this before. You'll be productive from week one, not ramping into it — there's no structured mentoring built into this seat.

What you'll do

  • Partner with Product Marketing and Digital leads at the intake stage of new initiatives — gather requirements, confirm feasibility, define timelines, and turn a brief into a structured, ownable plan
  • Own the GTM operating cadence: weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews, plus regular stand-ups with execution teams — agendas, pre-reads, decisions, and action tracking, end to end
  • Manage resource allocation across the four pods and four engine teams; resolve routine scheduling and capacity conflicts within a same-day SLA, and flag genuine trade-offs with options, not just problems
  • Own the roadmap tracker as the single source of truth across planning sheets and Jira; publish a weekly view of what's on track, at risk, or slipped, across every pod
  • Run launch readiness and QA reviews — confirm every deliverable meets the Definition of Done before it ships, and collect sign-offs
  • Lead resolution when something breaks: drive root-cause analysis, run blameless postmortems, and fix the process so it doesn't happen twice
  • Continuously improve how the team works — tighten templates, kill redundant meetings, and use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to speed up reporting and production workflows

What you'll bring

  • 5–8 years managing complex, cross-functional programs in a B2B SaaS or technology company — not single-team project management
  • PMP certification or equivalent formal program management training
  • Proven, specific experience owning a recurring business cadence end to end — not just attending one
  • Admin-level Jira fluency and advanced Google Sheets/Excel skills; working knowledge of Salesforce reporting
  • Demonstrated ability to drive outcomes through people who don't report to you, in a matrix structure
  • Sharp written communication — you can produce a status update a leader will read and a checklist a team will actually follow
  • A track record of structured QA and issue-escalation ownership, including postmortem discipline

Nice to have

  • Prior experience in a Product Marketing or GTM-specific program role
  • Familiarity with SaaS growth concepts: lead routing, attribution, campaign lifecycle management
  • Exposure to multi-geography GTM operations, especially India and the Middle East

data.title: Manager/Associate Manager-Channel Sales
data.description:
About Greytip Software:

Greytip is India's leading cloud HR and Payroll Software with more than 30,000+ customers. We serve our enterprise customers through SaaS solutions that leverage cutting edge technologies. Our mission is to improve people-centric practices and performance in Small, Mid and Large enterprises through our software solutions.


Job Summary

We are seeking a driven and results-oriented Manager/Associate Manager – Channel Sales to strengthen and expand our partner ecosystem. This role involves building, managing, and scaling channel relationships, driving revenue through indirect sales, and enabling partners for long-term growth. The ideal candidate will bring expertise in channel management, partner enablement, sales planning, and revenue acceleration, with a proven track record of delivering results in high-growth environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Channel Strategy & Planning – Develop and execute channel sales strategy aligned with business goals.
  • Partner Acquisition & Development – Identify, onboard, and nurture high-potential partners, resellers, and distributors.
  • Revenue Growth – Drive indirect sales through partners, achieve quarterly/annual revenue targets.
  • Enablement & Training – Provide product, sales, and solution enablement to partners to ensure effective go-to-market execution.
  • Relationship Management – Build strong executive-level relationships with key partners and stakeholders.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams to deliver partner success.
  • Performance Monitoring – Track partner sales performance, pipeline health, and market share contribution.
  • Market Insights – Gather and share competitive intelligence, partner feedback, and emerging trends to refine strategy.
  • Operational Excellence – Manage partner agreements, incentives, compliance, and reporting mechanisms.

Required Qualifications

Educational

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (mandatory).
  • MBA in Sales/Marketing or relevant certification in Channel/Partner Management (preferred).


Professional

  • 8–10 years of experience in channel sales, alliances, or partner management.
  • At least 3–4 years of team/partner management experience.
  • Proven success in building and scaling channel ecosystems.
  • Strong understanding of indirect sales models and partner lifecycle management.
  • Exposure to SaaS/Enterprise/B2B technology industries preferred.

data.title: Executive-Inside Sales
data.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a high-energy, customer-focused Inbound Inside Sales Executive to manage inbound leads and convert qualified prospects into sales opportunities.

The role involves understanding customer requirements, conducting structured discovery, building value around greytHR's solutions, nurturing prospects, and creating a strong sales pipeline for the Business Development team.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, disciplined, target-oriented and comfortable working in a high-volume inbound sales environment.


Key Responsibilities

1. Lead Management

  • Handle inbound leads generated through website, email, SEO, paid campaigns, webinars, LinkedIn and other marketing channels.
  • Respond to leads within defined Speed-to-Lead SLAs.
  • Prioritize high-intent leads and ensure timely follow-up.
  • Conduct initial research before engaging with prospects.

2. Lead Qualification

  • Understand the prospect's business, employee strength, industry and HR processes.
  • Identify the decision-maker and key stakeholders.
  • Understand the existing HRMS/payroll system and business challenges.
  • Identify requirements, buying timeline, budget and level of interest.
  • Qualify leads based on defined ICP and qualification criteria.

3. Discovery & Pipeline Creation

  • Conduct effective discovery conversations with prospects.
  • Identify pain points, business requirements and potential use cases.
  • Create qualified opportunities and move prospects through the defined sales stages.
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through systematic follow-ups.

4. Demo Conversion & Handover

  • Convert qualified prospects into product demonstrations.
  • Schedule demos with the appropriate Business Development Executive.
  • Provide a structured handover covering:
  • Customer background
  • Business requirement
  • Current HRMS
  • Pain points
  • Decision-maker
  • Expected timeline
  • Key areas to demonstrate
  • Ensure the BDE has sufficient context before the demo.

5. Follow-up & Nurturing

  • Follow up consistently with prospects who are not immediately ready.
  • Use appropriate channels including calls, email, WhatsApp and LinkedIn.
  • Re-engage ageing leads and previously unresponsive prospects.
  • Maintain follow-up discipline until the lead is converted, disqualified or closed.

6. Salesforce CRM Management

  • Maintain accurate and updated lead information in Salesforce.
  • Log every meaningful customer interaction.
  • Complete mandatory qualification fields.
  • Maintain accurate lead stages, dispositions, next actions and follow-up dates.
  • Ensure there are no leads without a clear next action.

7. Performance & Revenue Contribution

  • Achieve monthly and quarterly targets for:
  • Lead engagement
  • Qualified leads
  • Discovery conversations
  • Demos booked
  • Opportunities created
  • Pipeline value
  • Conversion rates
  • Track personal funnel performance and continuously improve conversion at each stage.


Required Skills

  • Strong verbal and written communication
  • Consultative selling
  • Lead qualification
  • Discovery and questioning skills
  • Objection handling
  • Follow-up and relationship management
  • Pipeline management
  • Salesforce/CRM proficiency
  • Good business understanding
  • Strong numerical and analytical ability
  • Ability to work with targets and deadlines


Preferred Candidate Profile

  • 1–4 years of experience in B2B SaaS / Inside Sales / Lead Qualification / Telesales
  • Experience handling inbound leads is preferred.
  • Experience selling SaaS, HRMS, payroll, ERP or business applications is an advantage.
  • Comfortable making high-volume outbound calls to inbound prospects.
  • Strong ownership of assigned leads and pipeline.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales/lead-generation targets.

data.title: Associate Product Manager - Payroll domain
data.description:
Associate Product Manager 

 

Position Purpose

Greytip Software is India’s largest cloud HR & Payroll software solutions company. With a customer base of over 35,000+, we touch the lives of more than 2 million employees daily. Our mission is to improve people-centric practices and performance in SMEs (Small & Medium Enterprises) through our cloud solution, greytHR.

We are seeking an Associate Product Manager to join our product team and ensure that our products remain competitive. As an Associate Product Manager, your duties will include working closely with the Development and Quality Assurance teams and other stakeholders, evaluating consumer feedback on our products, and finding solutions for product defects.


Duties & Responsibilities

You will:

  • Collaborate with the design, product development and QA teams.
  • Analyze requirements and support the engineering team to take a business call by providing PRD, User Stories, etc.
  • Work closely with cross-functional business teams on gathering product requirements and creating the product roadmap.
  • Gathering product data, including web analytics, statistics, and consumer trends.
  • Track product metrics and continuously try to improve them
  • Analyzing consumer feedback and recording product defects.
  • Determining improvements to product features.
  • Work with designers to create highly functional and delightful products for end-users.
  • Coordinating findings with the product team and aligning them with business goals.

Qualification & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree from a recognized university
  • 2 – 3 years of experience in a similar role.
  • Ability to analyze industry trends and competitor behavior.
  • Exceptional ability to identify improved product features and contribute to marketing strategies.
  • Competency in training internal departments on new product features.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Experience in HCM, payroll, Workforce management will be an added advantage.
